Problem: select() uses 'yoga'/'pilates' but host's actual category options are full strings like 'Pilates (Mat / Reformer)'. Form validation blocks submission.
Fix: Use host's actual studio_categories dynamically instead of hardcoded values.

Problem: ClassPlan::create() uses 'category' => 'yoga' which is not a valid category value. Should use full display string.
Fix: Use host->studio_categories[0] or array_key_first(ClassPlan::getCategories()) for seed data.

Problem: Dusk reuses browser session. Previous tests leave user logged in so guest tests don't redirect to /login.
Fix: Call ->logout() before visiting page in guest tests.

Problem: assertEquals('yoga', $classPlan->category) will fail once Issue 1 is fixed since stored value is full category string.
Fix: Assert against the actual category variable used in the test.
